description:
About the job

Futurum ya tiene una base desde la cual crecer: más de siete años de operación, programas educativos rentables, miles de alumnos atendidos y una plataforma propia con IA. Hasta ahora, growth ha sido operado directamente por los founders. Buscamos a la persona que tome esa experiencia y construya una operación de growth repetible, medible y cada vez más automatizada.




El reto empieza en México. Primero queremos mejorar el funnel de nuestros programas y validar la suscripción de la plataforma. Después queremos convertir lo aprendido en un playbook que nos permita llevar Futurum a más estudiantes de Latinoamérica.




Es un rol hands-on. Tendrás acceso directo al CEO, trabajarás cerca del CTO y podrás tomar decisiones sobre todo el funnel. Vas a encontrar tracción, conocimiento del mercado y productos que ya operan. También encontrarás datos fragmentados, procesos manuales y muchas oportunidades que todavía necesitan a alguien que las convierta en proyectos terminados.




Si te interesa entrar a una startup donde todavía puedes construir, experimentar y dejar tu forma de trabajar dentro de la empresa, probablemente hagas buen fit.




Sobre Futurum

Futurum es una startup mexicana de tecnología educativa para estudiantes que buscan entrar y avanzar en carreras de salud. Durante los últimos cuatro años, de cada 10 estudiantes que entraron a medicina en la UAQ, 5 pasaron por Futurum.




También construimos una plataforma propia con IA que hoy utilizan activamente 2,000 alumnos. El siguiente paso es validar su modelo de suscripción para estudiantes de medicina y después llevarlo a nuevos mercados.




Somos un equipo pequeño que trabaja desde Querétaro. Nos gusta probar rápido, medir y cambiar de decisión cuando los datos lo piden. Buscamos a alguien que quiera trabajar con esa libertad y también con la responsabilidad que viene con ella.




What you’ll own

Tendrás responsabilidad sobre el funnel end-to-end: adquisición, conversación, pago, uso y recompra. El objetivo es construir una operación que genere crecimiento y que dependa cada vez menos de seguimiento manual.




Durante tus primeros seis meses avanzarás en este orden:

Corregir y operar el funnel de nuestros programas.
Tomar ownership de paid media, landing pages y creativos.
Automatizar la operación comercial con IA.
Construir el funnel de suscripción de la plataforma.




Esperamos foco. Cada etapa deberá dejar procesos funcionando y aprendizajes que permitan decidir el siguiente paso.




What you’ll do

Operar el funnel desde adquisición hasta pago, uso y recompra.
Administrar Meta Ads end-to-end: campañas, presupuesto, optimización y resultados.
Entender cómo compran nuestros alumnos. Esto incluye responder y cerrar leads por WhatsApp cuando haga falta.
Convertir ese conocimiento comercial en mejores mensajes, automatizaciones y agentes.
Construir agentes para captar, calificar, dar seguimiento y reactivar leads.
Conectar Meta Ads, CRM, WhatsApp, pagos y producto mediante APIs y webhooks.
Crear workflows con n8n, Make, Zapier, modelos de lenguaje o código ligero.
Diseñar procesos human-in-the-loop, con evaluaciones, seguimiento de errores y rutas de escalamiento.
Lanzar experimentos en campañas, mensajes, landing pages, ofertas y procesos de venta.
Documentar cada experimento con hipótesis, métrica, resultado y siguiente decisión.
Construir dashboards que ayuden a decidir dónde invertir tiempo y presupuesto.
Crear prototipos de anuncios, landings y flujos con herramientas de IA.
Coordinar freelancers o agencias cuando una ejecución necesite apoyo especializado.
Trabajar con el CTO para definir qué debemos medir dentro del producto. El código de la plataforma seguirá bajo su responsabilidad.




Al inicio propondrás el gasto de las campañas. Conforme demuestres resultados, podrás operar con autonomía dentro de un presupuesto acordado.




What success looks like

Durante tus primeros 90 días esperamos que entiendas el funnel completo, identifiques dónde perdemos leads, pagos o información y construyas una baseline de las métricas disponibles.




También queremos ver automatizaciones comerciales en producción, una forma confiable de conectar adquisición con conversación y pago, y experimentos que terminen en decisiones. Al cerrar este periodo deberás contar con dashboards separados para programas y suscripción, además de un roadmap de growth para los siguientes seis meses.




Las primeras metas numéricas se fijarán en enero de 2027. Antes necesitamos medir bien el punto de partida.




Haces buen fit si

Tienes high agency y sabes avanzar con objetivos abiertos.
Has llevado proyectos de 0 a 1 y puedes mostrar lo que construiste.
Puedes explicar con claridad qué parte hiciste tú y qué resultado produjo.
Has operado funnels de growth, marketing o ventas.
Tienes experiencia práctica con paid media, CRM, landing pages y analytics.
Ya usaste IA para construir agentes, herramientas o automatizaciones que otras personas utilizaron.
Puedes conectar herramientas mediante APIs y webhooks.
Te sientes cómodo leyendo, adaptando o escribiendo código ligero.
Sabes trabajar con hipótesis, métricas y decisiones.
Entiendes que un proyecto de growth debe terminar conectado con revenue.
Puedes cuestionar una idea de los founders y sostener tu postura con información.
Tienes inglés B2 o superior.




Buscamos evidencia de ejecución. Queremos conocer proyectos que hayas llevado de inicio a fin, decisiones que hayas tomado y cosas que hayas aprendido después de lanzar.




La carrera universitaria es opcional. Haber trabajado en una startup suma. También suma haber construido un producto, negocio, funnel o herramienta por tu cuenta.




Extra points

Tener criterio visual puede ampliar mucho tu espacio de ejecución. Suma experiencia con Figma, Framer, Webflow, creative strategy, generación de imágenes, edición de video o motion.




Puedes hacer buen fit aunque diseño quede fuera de tu especialidad. En ese caso esperamos que puedas construir un prototipo, escribir un buen brief y coordinar el resultado con un freelancer o una agencia.




Lo que puedes construir aquí

Empezarás como individual contributor, sin personas a tu cargo. Tendrás espacio para diseñar cómo trabaja el área, escoger herramientas y proponer qué capacidades necesita el equipo. Conforme la función crezca, participarás con el CEO en la contratación y coordinación de nuevas personas.




El alcance del puesto puede crecer con los resultados. La dirección de largo plazo es llevar Futurum a más mercados de Latinoamérica. La siguiente etapa consiste en construir y probar ese playbook desde México.




Condiciones

$45,000 MXN brutos mensuales.
Prestaciones de ley.
Bono variable por resultados. El esquema se acordará antes de la contratación.
Presupuesto para las herramientas de software aprobadas que necesite el puesto.
Horario de lunes a viernes, de 9:00 a 18:00.
Modalidad presencial en Querétaro como primera opción.
Esquema híbrido negociable.
Podemos considerar trabajo remoto para un candidato excepcional.
Equipo de cómputo propio al comenzar.
Fecha ideal de entrada: 1 de octubre de 2026.




How to apply

Postúlate desde LinkedIn con tu CV. En esta primera etapa sólo necesitamos eso.




Si avanzas, te pediremos ejemplos de proyectos, funnels, experimentos o automatizaciones que hayas construido. Queremos entender qué hiciste tú, qué pusiste en producción, cómo mediste el resultado y qué aprendiste después.

About the job

About the Team

The DoorDash Campaign Operations team's mission is to efficiently deliver high quality, relevant CRM communications that meet the needs of our audiences, globally. To accomplish this mission, we're building a team of technical CRM and lifecycle marketing experts who build, QA, and launch email, push, SMS, and in-app campaigns designed by our Lifecycle Marketing partners. This team is goaled on high-quality campaign delivery and operational efficiency so that each campaign reaches the correct audience on-time with excellent craft.

About the Role

As the Senior Associate, Campaign Operations, you will be responsible for building, testing, and launching CRM and Lifecycle Marketing campaigns designed by our Lifecycle Marketing partners. This is a hands-on CRM execution and QA role — not a brand, content, social media, performance-marketing, or campaign-strategy position. You will partner closely with the Lifecycle Marketing team and Project Managers to ensure each campaign has completed all required steps prior to launch, and is delivered on time to the end-consumer, with high quality and excellent craft. You will be responsible for the high quality campaign delivery rate and production efficiency of each campaign launch. This role will report to the Campaign Ops Manager who sits in Mexico City.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Campaign QA & Execution: Build, test, and launch CRM and lifecycle marketing campaigns across email, push notifications, SMS, in-app messaging, and other channels using Braze and in-house tools. Own the end-to-end QA review process, build target audience segments and personalization logic, and collaborate with designers and copywriters to execute against the campaign brief.

Tool Expertise: Leverage Braze and other internal CRM/marketing automation platforms to implement sophisticated lifecycle campaigns, including automation, dynamic content, and A/B testing.


We're excited about you because you bring…

Majority of your day-to-day responsibilities (75%+) involved hands-on campaign execution — directly building, configuring, QAing, and launching lifecycle campaigns rather than primarily developing strategy or coordinating execution through other teams.

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

description:
About the job

Become an Online 1:1 Teacher with Tutero




⭐️ Teach from home. Earn in USD. Change students' lives. ⭐️




Tutero is an AI education company building the technology that lets great teachers do their best work — wherever they teach. We're hiring experienced online teachers across Mexico to deliver personalized, 1-on-1 lessons to students in the United States.




If you love teaching but are tired of crowded classrooms, endless prep, and admin that eats your evenings — this is teaching the way it should be.




Two things to check before you apply




1. You'll teach Mathematics. Our families usually need help in both Math and English, so we match teachers who can cover both subjects. The only exception: if you'll be teaching Mathematics, you can apply to teach that subject alone.

2. Apply in English. Your CV and your entire application must be written in English. Every lesson is taught in English to US students, so this is the first thing we look at — applications in Spanish won't move forward.




Availability requirements




We hire based on the hours you can cover, not just the subjects you teach. Our students are in the US, so lessons happen after their school day.




15+ hours per week, including 8+ hours between 4–10 PM ET (≈ 2–8 PM Mexico City)
Tell us your exact weekly availability in that window when you apply — the more hours you can offer, the more students we can match you with, and the more you earn
Ready to commit for at least 18 months — our students stay with the same teacher, so continuity matters (and it means steady, ongoing work for you)




Why teach with Tutero




Earn in USD — $13–17 per hour. Paid every fortnight by direct deposit to your Mexican bank account. Strong, reliable income from home.
We bring you the students. We match you with learners based on your subject strengths — no marketing, no chasing, no gaps to fill yourself.

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

About the job

Being part of the Driver Growth Operations team will give you the unique opportunity to help drive growth in one of the fastest growing companies ever. This data driven role calls for a rare combination of user-centric, analytical thinking & interpersonal ability. You will have the opportunity to work in a tight team, where you will launch, build and run DiDi's business in Spanish Speaking LatAm. Be prepared for a hectic, fast paced and challenging environment. Never a dull moment!

Driver Growth Operations team members are very important for the expansion and sustainability of the business. The ideal candidates for our opening roles should have very strong analytical skills (e.g. Python, R, SQL, etc.) and feel comfortable transforming insights into business decisions.

You will be constantly seeking solutions that scale, while overseeing the growth of our business. Your processes and projects will directly contribute to DiDi growth in LATAM!

In this role, you'll be...

Your responsibilities:


Design and implement initiatives to acquire new drivers, being able to leverage data for the decision making process.
Manage the launch and execution of incentives, projects, communications and product developments needed for driver acquisition, ensuring efficiency and expansion.
Be primary point of contact for internal stakeholders, managing expectations and prioritizing operations to deliver results, whilst constantly working along cross-functional teams (Marketing, Legal, City Operations, Product, etc).
Define and manage data dashboards to monitor national performance of driver acquisition and our results.
Ownership of driver acquisition incentives, across multiple countries in Spanish Speaking LatAm.
Constantly generate knowledge through experimental testing.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...

The successful applicant:


Bachelor's Degree: Engineering, Data Science, Actuary or any related field.
Growth / Marketplace experience: Experimental Testing, User Acquisition, Conversion, Habit Loops, PMF, GTM, Communication Strategies, Marketplace Balance, Pricing, etc
Resilient: proven to be self-motivated, self-directed, and eager to take ownership of tasks to ensure solutions.
User Centric: understanding the needs, motivation and detractors of ride-hailing Drivers to link with our Value Proposition.
Problem Solver with unique strength towards identifying bottlenecks and coming up with creative solutions.
Data-driven core: passion for data analytics and programming, with knowledge/experience in SQL (Nice to have: Python, R, etc.). Strong spreadsheet skills (Excel / Google Sheets) are a must. Comfortable about learning and using new software tools.
Effective communication skills. Proficiency in English & Spanish. We're an international team!



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

Representada en más de 50 países y con productos vendidos en más de 170, el Grupo Ferrero encanta a numerosas generaciones en todo el planeta. ¿Cuál es el secreto de nuestro éxito mundial? 40,000 empleados especializados que celebran tanto el cuidado como la calidad para forjar un negocio, carreras profesionales y marcas de las que nos sentimos orgullosos. Carreras con cuidado integrado: descubre nuestros beneficios aquí

Acerca de Ferrero:

Ferrero comenzó su trayectoria en la pequeña ciudad de Alba en Piamonte, Italia, en 1946. Hoy en día, es una de las empresas de alimentos dulces envasados más grandes del mundo, con muchas marcas icónicas que se venden en todo el mundo. Descubre más sobre Ferrero en ferrero.com

Consumidores, calidad y servicio son la clave de todo cuanto hacemos. Así pues, para cosechar el éxito en Ferrero, deberás orientarte al consumidor y al producto tanto como nosotros: dedicarte a lograr buenos resultados para los clientes en todo el mundo.

Creemos que todos nuestros empleados tienen el mismo talento, cada uno a su manera. Al fomentar la curiosidad y las habilidades naturales de nuestros empleados, les proporcionamos, generación tras generación, los medios para alcanzar el éxito personal y profesional, permitiéndoles forjar su trayectoria en Ferrero. La diversidad de nuestros talentos es lo que hace que nuestro entorno laboral sea multicultural, innovador y altamente gratificante. Descubre más aquí.

Build the appropriate balance of API, integration, component, contract, data, and end-to-end automation, minimizing unnecessary dependence on UI-level testing.

Participate in discovery, requirements refinement, technical design, and architecture discussions to identify edge cases, dependencies, testability concerns, and potential failure scenarios before development is complete.

Validate data across databases, APIs, files, and integrated systems using SQL and programmatic approaches. Verify data integrity, transformations, reconciliation, and complex backend processing when required.

Investigate failures using application logs, browser developer tools, network traces, API clients, database queries, and application telemetry. Distinguish between product defects, automation failures, test-data issues, infrastructure problems, and environment instability.

Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate test design, coding, debugging, documentation, and analysis while critically reviewing generated solutions and maintaining engineering standards.

5+ years of experience in an SDET, Software Engineer, Quality Engineer, Test Automation Engineer, or comparable engineering role, with experience delivering quality solutions for modern web applications, APIs, and integrated systems.

Strong software-development skills in at least one modern programming language. TypeScript/JavaScript or Python is strongly preferred. Ability to independently own quality engineering activities for a project or significant product area, proactively identifying problems and driving them to resolution without requiring detailed testing instructions. Ability to clearly communicate technical risks, constructively challenge assumptions, collaborate across technical and non-technical teams, and influence engineering decisions related to quality and testability.
Strong experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks for web applications and APIs. Hands-on experience with Playwright is strongly preferred.

Strong understanding of testing at different layers, including unit, component, API, integration, contract, data, and end-to-end testing, with the ability to determine which testing approach provides the most value for a given risk.

Strong experience testing REST APIs, JSON payloads, service integrations, backend workflows, and databases. Proficiency with SQL and experience validating data across integrated systems is highly valued.

Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent, with an understanding of automated quality gates and continuous delivery practices.
Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
Strong working knowledge of Git, branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, coding standards, and collaborative software-development practices.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to take ambiguous requirements or complex system designs and independently identify risks, edge cases, failure scenarios, dependencies, and appropriate validation approaches.

We promote long-term success, not just for our clients but for our team, helping you develop a professional roadmap that takes your career to new heights.

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to lead our test automation efforts across modern web applications and API services. In this role, you will build and scale end-to-end (E2E) testing suites using Playwright paired with Python and TypeScript. You will collaborate closely with full-stack engineers to embed robust test coverage directly into our continuous delivery pipelines.

Who You’ll Be Working With:

You will work closely with Software Engineers, Product Managers, Architects, DevOps Engineers, QA/QE professionals, and client stakeholders across delivery teams.

As a Senior SDET, you will serve as a technical quality partner within the team — participating in discovery, solution design, development, and release activities while helping teams identify risks early and build quality into the product rather than testing it only at the end of development.

What you'll be doing

Quality Engineering


Partner with engineering and product teams to understand business workflows, system architecture, integrations, and technical dependencies. Independently identify quality risks and define an appropriate testing and automation strategy.
Architect Scalable Automation Solutions. Design, develop, maintain, and continuously improve reliable automation frameworks and reusable test utilities for modern web applications, APIs, backend services, and integrated systems using technologies such as Playwright, TypeScript, and Python.
Build the appropriate balance of API, integration, component, contract, data, and end-to-end automation, minimizing unnecessary dependence on UI-level testing.
Participate in discovery, requirements refinement, technical design, and architecture discussions to identify edge cases, dependencies, testability concerns, and potential failure scenarios before development is complete.
Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and establish effective quality gates. Optimize execution through parallelization, tagging, test selection, environment management, reporting, and failure diagnostics.
Design robust API and integration validation for RESTful services and backend workflows, including request/response validation, authentication, error handling, service dependencies, and asynchronous processes.
Validate data across databases, APIs, files, and integrated systems using SQL and programmatic approaches. Verify data integrity, transformations, reconciliation, and complex backend processing when required.
Investigate failures using application logs, browser developer tools, network traces, API clients, database queries, and application telemetry. Distinguish between product defects, automation failures, test-data issues, infrastructure problems, and environment instability.
Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly to accelerate test design, coding, debugging, documentation, and analysis while critically reviewing generated solutions and maintaining engineering standards.


What you'll need to be successful (requirements)


5+ years of experience in an SDET, Software Engineer, Quality Engineer, Test Automation Engineer, or comparable engineering role, with experience delivering quality solutions for modern web applications, APIs, and integrated systems.
Strong software-development skills in at least one modern programming language. TypeScript/JavaScript or Python is strongly preferred. You should be comfortable designing maintainable software, working with existing codebases, debugging applications, and applying software-engineering principles rather than simply writing test scripts.
Ability to independently own quality engineering activities for a project or significant product area, proactively identifying problems and driving them to resolution without requiring detailed testing instructions. Ability to clearly communicate technical risks, constructively challenge assumptions, collaborate across technical and non-technical teams, and influence engineering decisions related to quality and testability.
Strong experience designing and maintaining automation frameworks for web applications and APIs. Hands-on experience with Playwright is strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of testing at different layers, including unit, component, API, integration, contract, data, and end-to-end testing, with the ability to determine which testing approach provides the most value for a given risk.
Strong experience testing REST APIs, JSON payloads, service integrations, backend workflows, and databases. Proficiency with SQL and experience validating data across integrated systems is highly valued.
Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using platforms such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent, with an understanding of automated quality gates and continuous delivery practices.
Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. 
Strong working knowledge of Git, branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, coding standards, and collaborative software-development practices.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to take ambiguous requirements or complex system designs and independently identify risks, edge cases, failure scenarios, dependencies, and appropriate validation approaches.


Note: Codal only communicates with candidates through official @codal.com email addresses. We never request payment during the hiring process. Please be vigilant regarding recruitment scams.

At Codal, we are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

description:
About the job

Company Description

Immunocine Cancer Center is dedicated to advancing revolutionary immunotherapy for cancer patients, particularly those ineligible for FDA clinical trials. At the core of our innovation is Immunocine Dendritic Cell Therapy (IDCT), a proprietary treatment that “double loads” a patient’s dendritic cells with their cancer cells to trigger a strong, targeted immune response. Backed by over 16 years of research and ongoing FDA trials, IDCT represents a less invasive and precise approach to treating various cancer types. Our mission is to provide cutting-edge, patient-centric treatments that bring renewed hope to those affected by cancer.




Role Description

This is a full-time, on-site position located in Cancún, ROO. As a Medical Doctor at Immunocine Cancer Center, you will be responsible for assessing and caring for cancer patients, developing and managing personalized treatment plans, and monitoring patient progress throughout therapy. You will collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to ensure optimal patient outcomes, maintain accurate medical records, and stay updated with the latest advancements in immunotherapy and cancer. You will also engage in patient education and provide compassionate care during their treatment journey.




Qualifications

Strong diagnostic and clinical decision-making skills, with the ability to assess and manage complex cases
Experience in oncology, immunology, or related medical fields
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with patients, families, and medical teams
Familiarity with immunotherapy treatments and willingness to engage in research and continuous education
Commitment to patient-centered care and a detail-oriented approach to maintaining accurate medical records
Medical degree (MD or equivalent) and valid medical license to practice in Mexico
Proficiency in both English and Spanish is preferred
Experience with nutrition and supplementation within cancer framework is a plus
Experience in clinical trials or advanced cancer treatment methodologies is a plus

They're looking for a Partnerships Associate to own the full partner lifecycle — from identifying and closing new partners to keeping every relationship running smoothly behind the scenes. This is a hybrid sales + operations role: you'll bring partners in, and you'll make sure they stay in.




Key Responsibilities

Proactively identify, pitch, and close new partners (brands, SaaS tools, service providers, experts) across affiliates, event sponsorships, and community offerings
Own partner outreach from first contact to signed agreement, writing tailored pitches and following up consistently
Support and lead sales conversations around sponsorships, affiliate programs, and event partnership packages
Manage the full contract lifecycle via Sign Now — sending, following up, filing, and auditing agreements
Execute complete partner onboarding: collecting assets, aligning on deliverables, updating the database, setting up offers
Manage affiliate partnerships end to end — tracking links, commission structures, promotions, and performance reporting
Track and execute all partner deliverables across events and campaigns, coordinating with internal teams
Maintain the partner database and app-facing partner page, ensuring accuracy and current information at all times

Produce AI-powered community insight summaries synthesizing partner-related discussions across community channels
Represent the company in person at US-based events a minimum of three times per year




Requirements

Must be able to travel to the US at least 3 times per year without visa or documentation issues (travel costs covered by the company)
3+ years of experience in partnerships, sales, business development, affiliate marketing, or a coordination-heavy operations role, managing multiple concurrent workstreams and partner relationships independently — mid to senior level
Demonstrated ability to own both sides of a relationship: outreach/sales AND organized follow-through/execution
Experience with CRM and project management tools (Airtable, ClickUp, HubSpot, Salesforce, Sign Now, or similar)
Strong written communication skills in English
Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent) to draft communications and synthesize content
Nice to have: experience in e-commerce, Amazon seller, SaaS, or DTC ecosystems
Nice to have: background in affiliate marketing (tracking links, commission setup, performance reporting)
Nice to have: experience building or improving SOPs and operational workflows




Ideal Candidate

This role is for someone who's equally comfortable sending a cold outreach email and cleaning up a database — someone who takes pride in an ecosystem where nothing slips. They don't need daily task lists to function; they know what needs attention and execute without being prompted. They're strong on both the sales side and the operational side — not just one or the other — and they treat database accuracy as core to the job, not overhead.

description:
About the job

Who We Are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

Hiring And How We Work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as our next Deal Desk Senior Analyst.

About The Job

Twilio is looking for a curious, action-oriented, strong financial analyst for the Deal Desk Team who lives the Twilio Magic to support our LATAM Go-to-Market motion. This is an exciting role for an individual to gain and expand a broad spectrum of cross-functional interactions and contribute to non-standard commercial agreements by providing rigorous financial governance and structuring. This role partners closely with Finance leadership, Sales, Legal, and Operations to evaluate, structure, and execute deals in a way that is a “win-win” for both customers and Twilio while optimizing corporate margin goals. The ideal candidate is a proactive, driven professional, able to build complex financial models and analyze pricing structures, while providing data-driven, financially sound, and clearly communicated explanations and solutions.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:


Build and analyze financial models and pricing scenarios for standard and non-standard agreements, evaluating critical variables including pricing, discounting, term length, usage commitments, and gross margin impact.
Partner with Sales to structure commercially sound deals by analyzing tradeoffs across price, volume, and risk, ensuring all structures align with Twilio’s financial guardrails.
Act as a guardrail and educator for Sales and GTM teams, ensuring adherence to internal contracting policies, approval matrices, and discount governance.
Own the end-to-end Deal Desk operational workflow in Salesforce/CPQ (from quote building and pricing approvals to Order Form creation, DocuSign execution, and opportunity closure), ensuring 100% data integrity and policy compliance.
Establish trusted working relationships across Commercial Legal, Billing Operations, Corporate Finance, and Sales to streamline deal velocity.
Collaborate with Sales and Legal to review and structure non-standard contract language within Order Forms, ensuring alignment with corporate risk and revenue recognition policies.
Conduct ad-hoc financial analysis and modeling to support broader business decisions and strategic initiatives.
Drive and participate in cross-functional project improvement initiatives to scale Deal Desk operations, enhance systems, and optimize internal workflows.


Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!


Required:
Business proficiency or fluency in English, with solid written and verbal communication skills.
A Bachelor’s or Associate’s Degree plus a minimum of 3 years of experience in Corporate Finance, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Commercial Finance, Deal Desk or an analytical Go To Market role. If no degree, a minimum of 5 years of relevant analytical experience is required.
Demonstrated analytical and financial skills, with a firm understanding of core financial concepts and the ability to explain financial tradeoffs clearly.
Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills, with proven experience building financial models, logic formulas, and scenario analyses.
A diligent, detail-oriented skillset, with the ability to manage multiple high-velocity requests simultaneously while remaining extremely organized under tight deadlines.
A self-starter with a “can-do” attitude who is comfortable asking clarifying questions and operating with high integrity that aligns with the Twilio Magic.


Desired


Knowledge and/or experience using online sales and/or document management tools such as Salesforce, Tableau, Looker, CLM, and JIRA.


Location

This role will be remote, and based in Mexico.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 5% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.





Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

description:
About the job

Sobre Brother

Brother es una compañía global con más de 115 años de historia, reconocida por desarrollar soluciones innovadoras para el hogar, la oficina y la industria.

En Brother México, con más de 30 años de presencia en el país, trabajamos bajo nuestra promesa “At your side”, buscando simplificar y enriquecer la vida de nuestros clientes, colaboradores y comunidades.




Nuestra cultura está impulsada por cuatro comportamientos clave: Responsabilidad, Autenticidad, Audacia y Excelencia, promoviendo un entorno diverso, inclusivo y colaborativo.




Sobre la posición

Buscamos un/a Analista de Marketing para apoyar el análisis y ejecución de las estrategias de marketing de nuestro portafolio de retail, contribuyendo al crecimiento de ventas y al posicionamiento de la marca Brother en el mercado.

Esta posición tendrá exposición a diferentes áreas del negocio y trabajará de manera cercana con Marketing, Ventas, clientes y equipos regionales/globales, combinando análisis de información, conocimiento de producto y ejecución comercial.




¿Qué harás?

📊 Análisis de producto y mercado

Analizar productos, precios, TCO, competencia y posicionamiento en los diferentes canales de venta.
Dar seguimiento a tendencias de mercado y Market Share, identificando oportunidades y riesgos.
Apoyar el análisis para lanzamientos de nuevos productos, posicionamiento y estrategias por canal.
Recopilar y analizar información relevante de clientes, mercado y competencia.




📈 Análisis comercial y desempeño

Dar seguimiento y analizar indicadores de Sell-In, Sell-Out, inventario, Forecast, crecimiento y mix de producto.
Preparar reportes y presentaciones sobre desempeño de productos y canales.
Apoyar análisis de GP, rentabilidad y ROI de productos y acciones comerciales.
Dar seguimiento a precios, price protection, fondos de marketing y gastos del portafolio.
Apoyar la preparación de información para procesos de Budget, Net Sales, GP y Forecast.




🤝 Soporte a Ventas y clientes

Colaborar con el equipo de Ventas en la ejecución y seguimiento de estrategias de Sell-Out.
Preparar briefs, presentaciones, comparativos y materiales de apoyo comercial.
Brindar soporte de marketing y producto a la fuerza de ventas.
Apoyar capacitaciones de producto para clientes internos y externos.
Participar en visitas de campo y contacto con clientes para recopilar información e identificar oportunidades.
Dar seguimiento y canalizar adecuadamente requerimientos o temas técnicos reportados por clientes.




🚀 Marketing & Demand Generation

Apoyar la planeación, ejecución y seguimiento de campañas de marketing y acciones comerciales.
Colaborar en la organización de eventos y actividades con clientes y canales.
Dar soporte a iniciativas de marketing digital y e-commerce, incluyendo website, contenido digital, redes sociales y product pages.
Dar seguimiento a los resultados de campañas y preparar análisis que permitan identificar oportunidades de mejora.
Coordinar materiales de marketing, traducciones y herramientas comerciales.




🌎 Colaboración regional y global

Apoyar la comunicación con equipos de Brother USA y Brother Japón relacionada con productos, lanzamientos y materiales de marketing.
Dar seguimiento a información y especificaciones de nuevos productos y empaques.
Apoyar procesos de pricing y Tender Support.
Participar en proyectos y actividades que pueden requerir viajes nacionales e internacionales.




¿Qué buscamos?

Licenciatura concluida en Marketing, Administración de Empresas, Negocios, Mercadotecnia o áreas afines.
Experiencia en Marketing, Product Marketing, Trade Marketing, Business Analysis o áreas comerciales relacionadas.
Interés y capacidad para trabajar con información comercial y de mercado.
Conocimiento de conceptos como Sell-In, Sell-Out, Forecast, Market Share y Pricing.
Manejo de Microsoft Office, especialmente Excel y PowerPoint.
Inglés avanzado, oral y escrito.
Disponibilidad para realizar viajes nacionales e internacionales.




Competencias clave

Buscamos una persona con:

🔎 Capacidad analítica y atención al detalle.
📈 Orientación a resultados y al negocio.
💡 Curiosidad y capacidad para identificar oportunidades.
🤝 Colaboración y trabajo en equipo.
💬 Comunicación efectiva.
📋 Planeación y organización.
🚀 Proactividad y aprendizaje continuo.
🎯 Capacidad para transformar datos en insights y acciones.




¿Por qué Brother?

Queremos que nuestros colaboradores puedan desarrollarse profesionalmente mientras mantienen un balance saludable entre su vida personal y profesional.

Entre nuestros beneficios y prácticas de trabajo encontrarás:

🏠 Esquema híbrido de trabajo.
🩺 Seguro de gastos médicos y seguro de vida.
💰 Programa de ahorro y beneficios financieros.
👨 👩 👧 Beneficios y permisos enfocados en momentos importantes para nuestros colaboradores y sus familias.
📚 Programas y recursos de aprendizaje y desarrollo.
👕 Código de vestimenta casual.
📅 Días adicionales de descanso durante el año.
🚗 Estacionamiento en nuestra oficina de Santa Fe.




Nuestra cultura

Nuestra misión es cumplir nuestra promesa “At your side”, simplificando y enriqueciendo la vida de nuestros clientes, colaboradores y comunidades.

Nos guiamos por nuestros impulsores culturales — Responsabilidad, Autenticidad, Audacia y Excelencia — que definen cómo colaboramos, tomamos decisiones y generamos resultados.

📍 Nuestra oficina corporativa en México está ubicada en Santa Fe, Ciudad de México.




Igualdad de oportunidades

Brother es un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades. Celebramos la diversidad y estamos comprometidos con construir un entorno inclusivo donde todas las personas sean respetadas y valoradas.

Damos la bienvenida a postulantes de todos los orígenes y no discriminamos por motivos de raza, género, edad, discapacidad, orientación sexual ni por cualquier otra condición protegida por la legislación aplicable.

¿Te apasiona el marketing, disfrutas analizar información y quieres desarrollar tu carrera combinando producto, datos y estrategia comercial en una compañía global? Queremos conocerte.

About the job

Customer Success Specialist




Acerca de Aldea

Aldea es una plataforma para la gestión y administración de centros educativos. Hoy ayudamos a más de 400 centros (kínderes, guarderías, primarias, centros de terapia, idiomas y deporte) a optimizar su comunicación, administración y procesos pedagógicos.

Nuestra misión es simplificar la operación de los centros educativos, reduciendo su carga administrativa y mejorando la comunicación con padres de familia, para que directores y maestros puedan enfocarse en lo más importante: la educación de los niños.




➡️ ¿Te apasiona esta visión?

¡Genial! Estamos ampliando nuestro equipo y creemos que esta oportunidad puede ser lo que estás buscando. Únete a una empresa 100% mexicana con presencia local y un producto diseñado para las necesidades de miles de centros en Latinoamérica.




➡️ Descripción del puesto

Como Customer Success Specialist, tu misión será asegurar que los centros educativos tengan la mejor experiencia posible con nuestra plataforma. Serás responsable de gestionar una cartera de centros educativos, asegurando su correcta incorporación, adopción y crecimiento dentro de la plataforma Aldea.

Este no es un rol únicamente reactivo: buscamos a alguien que gestione de forma proactiva la relación con sus clientes, identifique riesgos de churn y detecte oportunidades de expansión.

Tu principal objetivo será maximizar la retención, el uso de la plataforma y el crecimiento de tus cuentas.




Responsabilidades:

Realizar onboarding de nuevos clientes mediante videollamadas.
Gestionar cartera de clientes, construyendo relaciones a largo plazo.
Dar seguimiento continuo para asegurar adopción y uso activo de la plataforma.
Mantener comunicación constante con clientes (llamadas, correo, mensajes).
Detectar riesgos de churn y actuar de forma oportuna.
Identificar oportunidades de expansión (upsell y cross-sell).
Atender y canalizar incidencias al equipo de Soporte.
Analizar métricas de uso, retención y satisfacción (NPS).
Recopilar feedback de clientes y compartirlo con Producto y Desarrollo.
Dar seguimiento al proceso de alta con proveedores de pago.




Competencias y cualificaciones deseadas

1 - 3 años de experiencia en Customer Success, Account Management o roles similares de atención/fidelizacion de clientes.
Experiencia gestionando cartera de clientes (no solo atención reactiva).
Experiencia en SaaS o tecnología (deseable).
Fuerte orientación al cliente y a resultados.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación verbal y escrita.
Capacidad analítica y comodidad trabajando con métricas.
Organización y manejo de múltiples cuentas y tareas.
Experiencia con CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive o similares).
Inglés intermedio-avanzado.
Paciencia, empatía, proactividad y orientación al cliente.




Medición de resultados

Retención de clientes.
Nivel de adopción y uso de la plataforma.
NPS y satisfacción del cliente.
Expansión de cuentas (upsell/cross-sell).




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Sueldo mensual bruto: $22,000 - $25,000 (Acorde a experiencia).
Impacto directo en el sector educativo.
Crecimiento profesional en una startup en expansión.
Equipo dinámico y cultura enfocada en resultados.

title: Paid Acquisition Manager
skills: Meta and Google as core paid channels, expanding to Pinterest, YouTube, or others as they qualify on the numbers.
Account structure, campaign architecture, audience strategy, bid strategy, and day-to-day budget pacing.
The daily discipline of deciding where the next marginal dollar goes, including the discipline to leave it unspent when the account doesn't support it.
Operating within a defined spend gate tied to sustained contribution or blended MER performance — spend scales in governed steps as performance clears agreed thresholds, not on a fixed schedule.
Blended MER and contribution economics after COGS, fulfillment, returns, and media cost, not platform-reported ROAS alone.
Applying a realistic haircut to platform-reported return metrics before planning against them.
CAC ceilings set from the lifecycle team's cohort and LTV data, not from a platform dashboard metric.
A structured creative testing calendar in partnership with the Creative Producer — every test has a stated hypothesis, a minimum sample size, and a kill criterion set before launch.
Winner scaling and fatigue monitoring: tracking frequency, CPM drift, and knowing when a winning ad is done.
Incrementality testing, geo holdouts or spend-down tests on a regular cadence, and understanding how much of reported non-brand conversion is actually incremental versus cannibalized branded search.
Working with the CRO/merchandising owner to ensure traffic and landing pages are matched, even though you don't own the page itself.
Clear, regular reporting on account performance, test results, and the reasoning behind every scale-up or pull-back decision.

You have personally held a blended MER or contribution target on an account with $100,000 or more in monthly governed spend, sustained over a period of at least six months, and can name the brand, the dates, and the results.
You can describe a specific time you reduced or stopped spend on something that looked good on the dashboard, the threshold you used, who disagreed, and what happened afterward.
You can do the arithmetic: given margin, AOV, and cost structure, you can derive break-even MER and a maximum sustainable CAC without hesitation.
You understand the limitations of platform-reported ROAS and can explain what you actually plan against instead.
You have run or closely partnered on incrementality testing, geo holdouts, spend-down tests, or branded search cannibalization checks, and can speak to what you learned.
You can provide a reference or verifiable artifact for your results; claims will be checked before a final offer.
You're comfortable operating inside a governed spend gate rather than pushing to scale spend as fast as possible.
You can commit to substantial same-day overlap with US Eastern hours — pacing and budget decisions happen daily.
Experience in bedding, home goods, or textiles.
Agency-side and brand-side experience.
Direct experience partnering with an in-house or contracted creative producer on a structured test calendar.
Experience managing paid media across more than one brand simultaneously.
Familiarity with server-side tracking, CAPI, or first-party data approaches in a post-iOS14 environment.
Full account audit complete.
A clear point of view on account health.
A documented test calendar in motion.
Every spend and scale decision is explainable in contribution terms.
Incrementality testing is underway.
Reporting is decision-grade.
Sustained MER performance at each new spend level.
A clean track record of test hypotheses and kill criteria.
A working rhythm with lifecycle and creative that keeps CAC disciplined as volume grows.
Competitive salary based on experience.
Fully remote position. Work from anywhere.
Direct access to the CEO. Your ideas and analysis reach the decision-maker, not a middle manager.
Advanced tooling and infrastructure, including AI-powered analytics, custom dashboards, and automated reporting that let you focus on strategy instead of data entry.
A team that values data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement.

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We're hiring the person who will own paid acquisition for our DTC channel as it moves from a controlled, governed starting point toward meaningful scale. This is fundamentally an economics role before it is a media-buying role: the person we hire will operate inside clear contribution and measurement guardrails, and will be trusted to leave budget unspent when the numbers don't support deploying it.

Recruiting this role does not itself authorize increased ad spend—spend scales in steps, gated by sustained contribution performance, not by hire date. If you're energized by proving out an account methodically and scaling only what's actually working, this role is built for you.




ABOUT US

Ecotero LLC operates five private-label brands led by DECOLURE in premium bedding and home textiles. Amazon is the mature channel at $18M+ annually across roughly 703 SKUs. TikTok Shop does roughly $4.5M and is growing. DTC on Shopify is early.

We are a 27-person distributed team. The analytical infrastructure here is unusual for a business this size: SKU-level COGS across the full catalogue, daily API pipelines into PostgreSQL, competitor tracking, and AI operational agents that produce weekly audit drafts, anomaly flags and performance reports for your review.




SCOPE OF THIS ROLE

This role reports directly to the Head of DTC. You'll own the ad accounts and day-to-day media decisions, but spend authorization is governed separately and is not automatically unlocked by this hire—increases are tied to sustained, measured contribution performance.

You'll work closely with the Lifecycle and Retention Manager, whose cohort and LTV reporting sets your CAC ceiling, and with the Paid Social Creative Producer, who supplies and iterates on creative based on your test results.




You do not own landing page development or on-site conversion optimization directly, though you'll partner closely with whoever does to make sure traffic and landing experience are aligned.

As the channel matures, this role's scope is expected to grow into a broader acquisition function with additional specialists; today, it's a hands-on, individually owned seat.




WHAT YOU OWN

Meta and Google as core paid channels, expanding to Pinterest, YouTube, or others as they qualify on the numbers.
Account structure, campaign architecture, audience strategy, bid strategy, and day-to-day budget pacing.
The daily discipline of deciding where the next marginal dollar goes, including the discipline to leave it unspent when the account doesn't support it.
Operating within a defined spend gate tied to sustained contribution or blended MER performance — spend scales in governed steps as performance clears agreed thresholds, not on a fixed schedule.
Blended MER and contribution economics after COGS, fulfillment, returns, and media cost, not platform-reported ROAS alone.
Applying a realistic haircut to platform-reported return metrics before planning against them.
CAC ceilings set from the lifecycle team's cohort and LTV data, not from a platform dashboard metric.
A structured creative testing calendar in partnership with the Creative Producer — every test has a stated hypothesis, a minimum sample size, and a kill criterion set before launch.
Winner scaling and fatigue monitoring: tracking frequency, CPM drift, and knowing when a winning ad is done.
Incrementality testing, geo holdouts or spend-down tests on a regular cadence, and understanding how much of reported non-brand conversion is actually incremental versus cannibalized branded search.
Working with the CRO/merchandising owner to ensure traffic and landing pages are matched, even though you don't own the page itself.
Clear, regular reporting on account performance, test results, and the reasoning behind every scale-up or pull-back decision.




REQUIRED EVIDENCE

Required:

You have personally held a blended MER or contribution target on an account with $100,000 or more in monthly governed spend, sustained over a period of at least six months, and can name the brand, the dates, and the results.
You can describe a specific time you reduced or stopped spend on something that looked good on the dashboard, the threshold you used, who disagreed, and what happened afterward.
You can do the arithmetic: given margin, AOV, and cost structure, you can derive break-even MER and a maximum sustainable CAC without hesitation.
You understand the limitations of platform-reported ROAS and can explain what you actually plan against instead.
You have run or closely partnered on incrementality testing, geo holdouts, spend-down tests, or branded search cannibalization checks, and can speak to what you learned.
You can provide a reference or verifiable artifact for your results; claims will be checked before a final offer.
You're comfortable operating inside a governed spend gate rather than pushing to scale spend as fast as possible.
You can commit to substantial same-day overlap with US Eastern hours — pacing and budget decisions happen daily.




Preferred:

Experience in bedding, home goods, or textiles.
Agency-side and brand-side experience.
Direct experience partnering with an in-house or contracted creative producer on a structured test calendar.
Experience managing paid media across more than one brand simultaneously.
Familiarity with server-side tracking, CAPI, or first-party data approaches in a post-iOS14 environment.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In the first 30 days:

Full account audit complete.
A clear point of view on account health.
A documented test calendar in motion.




In the first 90 days:

Every spend and scale decision is explainable in contribution terms.
Incrementality testing is underway.
Reporting is decision-grade.




As the spend gate clears in governed steps:

Sustained MER performance at each new spend level.
A clean track record of test hypotheses and kill criteria.
A working rhythm with lifecycle and creative that keeps CAC disciplined as volume grows.




WHAT YOU'LL GET

Competitive salary based on experience.
Fully remote position. Work from anywhere.
Direct access to the CEO. Your ideas and analysis reach the decision-maker, not a middle manager.
Advanced tooling and infrastructure, including AI-powered analytics, custom dashboards, and automated reporting that let you focus on strategy instead of data entry.
A team that values data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement.
Opportunities for growth as the company expands into new marketplaces and channels.
Employee discounts on Decolure products.

description:
About the job

¿Qué es Kiwik?

Kiwik es la plataforma de mercados de predicción de Latinoamérica.




Un mercado de predicción convierte una pregunta sobre el futuro en un precio. Los participantes toman una posición sobre el resultado, el precio se mueve con lo que creen colectivamente, y ese precio termina siendo la mejor estimación disponible de qué tan probable es que algo ocurra. Es una encuesta sin sesgos: nadie contesta lo que cree que quieres oír, porque cada respuesta tiene un costo. Los mercados de predicción están cambiando la forma en que se toman decisiones.




Eso es lo que estamos construyendo con Kiwik desde México. Cubrimos deportes, política, economía, espectáculos y ciencia. Si te gusta llegar cuando las cosas todavía se están definiendo, este es el momento.




Sobre el Rol

El Operador de Mercado es un puesto de tiempo completo que puede ser remoto. Es un rol clave dentro de la compañía, no un puesto de apoyo: el operador es dueño del P&L de los mercados que crea, y su compensación variable depende directamente del rendimiento financiero de su libro.




Dicho simple: tú decides qué preguntas existen en Kiwik, cómo se pagan y cómo se administran.




La persona en este rol es responsable del ciclo de vida completo de un portafolio de mercados dentro de una vertical asignada: deportes, política y economía, o espectáculos. Eso implica leer la conversación del momento y convertirla en una pregunta que la gente quiera operar; redactar reglas de resolución que no admitan interpretación, nombrando la fuente oficial, el umbral exacto y la fecha exacta; seleccionar el tier del mercado y fijar el precio de apertura conforme a los parámetros que define el área de riesgo; y coordinar con marketing la promoción, proponiendo copy, activando creadores y líderes de opinion, eligiendo el momento exacto de publicación.




El operador monitorea sus mercados en vivo, detecta anomalías, propone mercados derivados cuando algo agarra tracción, y ejecuta la resolución con evidencia documentada dentro de los SLAs establecidos, manejando disputas cuando surgen. Valida que los cierres automáticos se hayan ejecutado correctamente y escala cualquier incidencia al equipo técnico. 




Adicionalmente, identifica oportunidades de patrocinio, alianza o co-creación con creadores y las presenta al área comercial para su estructuración.




El rol reporta a el Head de Mercados, con exposición frecuente al Chief Product Officer (CPO) y Chief Finance Officer (CFO). Participa en una revisión semanal de negocio con el CEO, y tiene una trayectoria de crecimiento definida hacia Operador Sr., Lead de vertical y Head of Markets.




¿Que buscamos?

Interés por cómo funciona un mercado: qué hace que un precio se mueva, cómo se estima una probabilidad, y cómo se sostiene un libro rentable. No necesitas traerlo aprendido, pero sí querer aprenderlo rápido.
Pulso digital: sabes qué está moviendo redes hoy, conoces líderes de opinión y no te molesta el hustle de buscar alianzas con creadores o sitios.
Precisión al escribir: Buena parte del trabajo es redactar reglas que no admitan interpretación: qué se mide exactamente, según qué fuente oficial, y en qué fecha.
Criterio: para distinguir entre un tema del que todo el mundo habla y un evento que efectivamente se puede verificar y resolver.
Instinto comercial y mentalidad de dueño: identificas oportunidades de negocio —patrocinios, alianzas, colaboraciones con creadores— y las traes a la mesa sin que nadie te lo pida.
Habilidad para trabajar con datos y sistemas: hojas de cálculo, dashboards, herramientas de análisis e IA.

description:
About the job

Location: Mexico (preferred) | Hybrid / Remote




About Sarelly

Sarelly is building more than a beauty brand: we’re building an entertainment and culture-driven beauty company for the next generation of Latina consumers.

As we expand into the U.S., we’re building a Consumer Intelligence capability that combines first-party data, social conversations, consumer communities, research and AI to bring the voice of the consumer closer to how we build products, brands and experiences.

We’re looking for someone to build and lead that capability.




The Opportunity

This is not a traditional Consumer & Market Insights role.

We’re looking for someone deeply curious about consumers, passionate about products, highly comfortable with AI, and excited to operate inside the business, not simply deliver research to it.

Your mission: Turn consumer understanding into better products and better business decisions.

You will be a close strategic partner to Product Development, while supporting Brand, Growth, Retail and leadership with actionable consumer intelligence.

You will also work with an AI/Data Architect responsible for the technical infrastructure behind our Consumer Intelligence Hub. Your role is to own the consumer questions, insights, interpretation and business application, not the data architecture.




Key Responsibilities1. Put Consumer Intelligence at the Heart of Product Development

Product Development will be one of your closest partners. You’ll work across the innovation process, from identifying unmet needs and white spaces to concept development, product testing and post-launch learning.

You will:

Identify consumer needs, frustrations, behaviors and beauty routines that can inspire new products.
Translate insights into product opportunities and innovation briefs.
Bring consumer evidence into product prioritization and key development decisions.
Design fast, effective ways to test concepts, claims, shades, formulas, packaging and propositions.
Turn learnings from existing products and launches into future innovation opportunities.
Help identify opportunities to strengthen Sarelly’s hero products and franchises.

The goal is to move Consumer Intelligence upstream: from validating ideas after they exist to helping determine what we should build in the first place.




2. Build Sarelly’s Consumer Intelligence Capability

Build a continuous understanding of our consumers by connecting signals across first-party data, research, social conversations, reviews, CRM, creators and communities, retail, and cultural and category trends.

Organize intelligence around the questions the business needs to answer, identify knowledge gaps, and determine the fastest and most effective way to answer them.

Turn those signals into clear recommendations: What are we seeing? Why does it matter? What should we do about it?

Make Consumer Intelligence accessible and actionable across the organization and help build a more consumer-led culture at Sarelly.




3. Become an Expert on Latina Beauty Consumers

Help Sarelly develop a nuanced understanding of Latina beauty consumers across Mexico and the U.S, including differences in cultural identities, beauty concerns and routines, product needs, language, shopping behaviors, generations and markets.

We don’t believe in treating the Latina consumer as one homogeneous audience. You’ll help us understand the nuances that drive meaningful product and cultural relevance.




4. Make AI Part of How You Work

We want someone who is AI-native in their day-to-day working style. You don’t need to be an engineer or architect our data infrastructure, but you should actively use AI to make your work faster, deeper and smarter.

You should be comfortable using AI to:

Analyze and synthesize large volumes of consumer feedback.
Identify patterns across reviews, social conversations and research.
Accelerate competitive, category and consumer research.
Develop hypotheses and research approaches.
Create repeatable AI-powered research and analysis workflows.
Continuously experiment with new tools and approaches.

Experience building or using AI agents and agentic workflows is a strong plus.




Required Experience
3–5 years in Consumer Insights, Consumer Strategy, Innovation, Product Insights or a related discipline.
Experience working in-house within a consumer brand / CPG company.
Experience partnering directly with Product Development, Innovation or R&D teams.
Strong interest in products and what drives consumer adoption.
Strong qualitative research, analytical and strategic thinking skills.
Ability to translate consumer research into clear product and business recommendations.
Strong understanding of research methodologies and when to use them.
Hands-on use of AI tools as part of your professional workflow.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills.
Fluent in English and Spanish.

Experience at research companies such as Ipsos, Circana or Kantar is valuable, but in-house consumer brand experience is important for this role.




Preferred Experience
Beauty or personal care
Product innovation / consumer-led product development
U.S. Hispanic / Latina consumers
Mexican and U.S. markets
Social listening and digital consumer intelligence
Community-led or culturally driven brands
AI-powered research workflows or agents




The Mindset We’re Looking For

You are:

Product obsessed: curious about why consumers love, reject, repurchase or abandon products.
A business partner, not just a researcher: you want insights to influence decisions.
AI-native: you experiment with AI and continuously look for smarter ways to work.
Curious about people, culture and behavior.
Comfortable challenging assumptions and connecting dots.
Pragmatic/ Start up mindset: you know when rigorous research is needed and when a fast directional answer is enough.
Excited to build a capability from the ground up.




Why Join Sarelly?

This is an opportunity to build Consumer Intelligence from the ground up and directly influence what a fast-growing beauty brand creates next.

You’ll help define a new model where consumer understanding, Product Development, AI and human judgment work together to create better products and better decisions.

description:
About the job

At Jellyfish we believe that our individual differences are our greatest assets. We are passionate about empowering every employee to reach their full potential and contribute their unique perspectives to our collaborative environment. We are an equal opportunity employer and firmly believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce drives innovation and leads to better solutions. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other personal characteristics that make them who they are.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

We are seeking a highly analytical and creative-minded Creative Intelligence Analyst to join our team. This role is designed to bridge the gap between media performance and creative production. You will be responsible for dissecting creative performance data to understand why certain ads perform better than others, translating those insights into actionable strategies for our creative and media teams. You will work closely with our Creative/Pencil Lead and Media Buyers to optimize our creative output based on rigorous data analysis.

Key Responsibilities


 Creative Performance Analysis & Reporting
Analyze the performance of creative assets across various platforms (Meta, TikTok, YouTube, etc.) to identify winning patterns and elements.
Evaluate creative components such as hooks, visuals, copy, and CTAs to determine their impact on key performance indicators (KPIs) like CTR, CPA, and ROAS.
Build and maintain comprehensive dashboards and reports that focus specifically on creative efficacy.
 Strategic Bridge & Briefing
Act as the primary liaison between the Media/Data teams and the Creative/Production teams.
Translate media performance data into creative "lessons learned" and actionable creative briefs for future production.
Collaborate with the Creative/Pencil Lead to integrate AI-driven insights into the creative workflow.
 Testing & Optimization Frameworks
Develop and manage a robust creative testing roadmap, including A/B testing and multivariate testing protocols.
Provide data-backed recommendations for creative iterations and optimizations.
Oversee the metadata tagging process for creative assets to ensure granular data collection and analysis.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration
Participate in regular cross-departmental syncs to align creative production with media buying strategies.
Educate the creative team on performance metrics and how their work impacts the bottom line.
Stay ahead of industry trends and platform updates to ensure our creative strategies remain cutting-edge.


Requirements & Skills

Experience: 3-5 years of experience in media analysis, digital marketing, or a performance-driven creative role. Advanced English proficiency. 

Analytical Skills: Proficiency in data analysis tools (Excel, SQL, Google Data Studio, Tableau) and platform native analytics.

Platform Knowledge: Deep understanding of Paid Social and Programmatic ads platforms

Creative Intuition: A strong grasp of storytelling, visual design principles, and what resonates with audiences on social media.

Tool Proficiency: Experience with AI-driven creative tools (e.g., Pencil) and creative management platforms is highly desirable.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💰 Savings fund: You'll save 5% of your monthly income and Jellyfish will contribute the same amount you save to your savings fund.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

🏥 Health Insurance: We provide a private health insurance policy that includes visual and dental plan coverage.

Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to talentacquisition@jellyfish.com.
