description:
About the job

Creative Content Strategist | YouTube & Long-Form Video

Remote | Part-Time | 20 Hours/Week




About the Role

We are looking for a highly creative Creative Content Strategist to take ownership of the strategy and creative direction behind a growing YouTube channel focused on business, marketing, entrepreneurship, and education.




This is a behind-the-scenes creative role. You will be responsible for continuously researching new ideas, developing original video concepts, creating stories and narratives, writing scripts, building storyboards, researching filming locations, and helping shape what each video should look and feel like before the founders step in front of the camera.

The ideal candidate understands YouTube content, storytelling, business, and digital marketing and knows how to turn business expertise into compelling content that people actually want to watch.




Key Responsibilities

Own the creative strategy and content planning for the YouTube channel.
Research and develop new, original video ideas on an ongoing basis.
Study successful YouTube channels and identify formats, storytelling approaches, hooks, and concepts that can be adapted to the brand.
Develop compelling video concepts around business, entrepreneurship, marketing, and real-world business stories.
Create storylines and narratives that make educational content engaging and entertaining.
Write and structure scripts for long-form YouTube videos.
Develop storyboards and detailed creative directions for each video.
Determine the hook, structure, pacing, key talking points, and overall narrative of each piece.
Interview or collaborate with the founders to extract stories, experiences, insights, and expertise that can become strong content.
Research interesting entrepreneurs, businesses, trends, case studies, and potential collaboration opportunities.
Identify and reach out to potential entrepreneurs or business owners for collaborations and guest appearances.
Research visually interesting filming locations in Miami, including hotels, venues, high-rise spaces, businesses, and other unique environments.
Provide creative direction for filming setups, locations, environments, and overall visual presentation.
Prepare the founders with everything they need before filming so they can execute the content efficiently.
Collaborate with the long-form video editor and clearly communicate the intended creative direction.
Help establish a repeatable YouTube content production system and maintain an organized content pipeline.
Develop approximately one long-form YouTube video per week, with additional shorter long-form content as needed.




Content Focus:

The content will primarily revolve around:

Business and entrepreneurship
Digital marketing
Business growth and strategy
Educational content
Entrepreneurial stories and interviews
Case studies and business lessons
Personal branding and founder-led content
Interesting business trends and real-world stories

The goal is to create content that educates, entertains, and builds authority, rather than feeling like traditional advertising.




What We're Looking For

Strong understanding of YouTube content strategy and storytelling.
Demonstrated experience creating or developing long-form YouTube content.
Excellent creative instincts and the ability to consistently generate fresh, original ideas.
Strong scripting and storytelling skills.
Ability to think visually and imagine how a video should look before it is filmed.
Understanding of hooks, retention, pacing, narrative structure, and audience psychology.
Strong research skills and curiosity about business, entrepreneurship, marketing, and financial topics.
Basic understanding of digital marketing and business concepts.
Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with founders.
Organized, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership of the creative process.
Ability to research and identify interesting filming locations and environments.
Comfortable researching and reaching out to entrepreneurs for potential collaborations.
Experience with B2B content marketing, educational content, consulting, podcasting, or founder-led content is a plus.
A portfolio of YouTube videos or relevant long-form content is required.




Important Role Clarification

Video editing is NOT the primary responsibility of this position.




A dedicated video editor will handle the editing. Your responsibility is to define what should be created and how it should be created—from the initial idea and research through the story, script, storyboard, filming plan, and creative direction.

You will essentially act as the creative director and strategic brain behind the YouTube channel.

You do not need to live in Miami. However, you should be comfortable researching Miami locations remotely using tools such as Google Maps, venue websites, and other online resources.




Experience

We are open to candidates across different experience levels.

A highly experienced YouTube strategist is welcome, but we are equally interested in junior or mid-level candidates who demonstrate exceptional creative thinking, strong storytelling ability, and a genuine understanding of what makes YouTube content compelling.

Your portfolio and creative instincts matter more than a specific number of years of experience.




Schedule

Part-Time
Approximately 20 hours/week to start
Flexible remote schedule
Opportunity to increase hours and responsibilities as the content operation grows

description:
About the job

Job Description

Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

Where And How You Can Work

Alongside our global campuses, we also collaborate with talented contractors and freelancers from all over the world to help us achieve our crazy big goals. While we support flexible, remote-friendly ways of working, for this role we’re focusing on Mexico City so we can best support our teams and keep collaboration flowing.

This role is a 12 month engagement, working full time hours per week.

What You’d Be Doing In This Role

As Creative Strategist for Mexico, you’ll be the creative performance engine behind Canva’s paid marketing in the region.

This role sits at the intersection of Creative, Growth, and Data - combining cultural insight, analytical depth, and creative instinct to continuously improve our performance marketing output. You won’t be running bids day-to-day - you’ll be driving the creative strategy that makes those campaigns win.

If you love decoding what makes a hook scroll-stopping, turning insights into structured testing, and raising the creative bar sprint after sprint, this role is for you.

At The Moment, This Role Is Focused On


Leading the full creative cycle - research, briefing, production, and performance review — running weekly sprint cycles that balance quick-win iterations with bigger creative swings, and feeding learnings back to the broader team after every sprint
Digging into performance dashboards to spot winning patterns, diagnose underperformance, and translate insights into clear, actionable creative direction that drives the next round of concepts
Directing and collaborating with video editors, designers, writers, and local creators to produce high-quality work across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging channels - briefing and reviewing content to keep it on-brand, culturally relevant, and platform-optimised
Bringing deep cultural fluency to every brief - identifying Mexican audience behaviours, regional trends, and platform dynamics that shape compelling, locally resonant storytelling
Working closely with media buyers, data science, and the LatAm Growth Marketing Lead to make sure creative insights translate into measurable business outcomes
Driving CRO initiatives that improve acquisition journeys and lift conversion efficiency across key touchpoints
Using AI tools to accelerate ideation, research, asset generation, and analysis - and staying across emerging formats and creative tech that give the team an edge



You’re Probably a Match If


You have solid experience in growth or performance marketing with a strong focus on creative strategy - and you've worked hands-on across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube
You can lead structured creative testing and sprint frameworks, analyse what's working, and turn those learnings into clear briefs for the next cycle
You have strong creative instinct - you know what makes a hook scroll-stopping, a format compelling, and a concept scalable across channels
You're fluent in Spanish and English, with a sharp eye for tone, nuance, and cultural resonance for Mexican audiences
You have experience briefing, directing, and iterating with creative talent — video editors, designers, writers, and creators - coaching them to produce performance-driven work
You're confident using dashboards and analytics tools to inform decisions and optimise creative at scale
You use AI tools to accelerate your workflow and improve output quality



Meet the team

We're Canva's LatAm Marketing group, and our mission is to make Canva the most loved brand in the region. We build culturally resonant, high-impact marketing across Latin America - combining bold creative storytelling with sharp performance thinking to drive visibility and growth, market by market. Mexico is a key focus for us right now, and this role sits right at the heart of that ambition.

How We Hire

We make decisions to engage contractors based on your experience, skills and passion.

When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

We celebrate all types of skills and backgrounds at Canva so even if you don't feel like your skills quite match what's listed above - we still want to hear from you!

Please note that all interviews are conducted virtually.

This role applies advanced software engineering and big data expertise to create reliable, high-quality data products that enable teams to deliver innovative customer experiences and data-informed decisions.

This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events.

In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location.

Who you are

You will get to


Architect and implement scalable, secure, and observable data pipelines and services that collect, process, and store large, diverse data sets to support analytics, machine learning, and product use cases. 
Design and optimize data models, storage patterns, and processing frameworks to meet performance, reliability, and cost objectives for high-volume, real-time, and batch workloads. 
Lead technical design reviews, code reviews, and best-practice guidance for Big Data solutions, mentoring engineers on topics such as data quality, resiliency, and operational excellence. 
Collaborate with product, analytics, data science, and platform engineering teams to translate business and modeling requirements into robust, production-grade data solutions and APIs. 
Implement and maintain automated testing, monitoring, and alerting for data services, proactively improving reliability, data quality, and incident response. 
Evaluate and introduce new big data technologies, tools, and patterns to improve developer productivity, platform scalability, and end-to-end data lifecycle management. 
Document data flows, interfaces, and operational runbooks, and contribute to shared standards and patterns for Big Data engineering across the organization. 


Who You Are


Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 
5+ years of experience in software engineering with a focus on building and operating data-intensive or distributed systems. 
Expert level proficiency in SQL and Python
Strong experience with Big Data technologies, including Spark/Flink, and cloud platforms like AWS and Databricks. 
Experience designing, implementing, and supporting production data pipelines and platforms using modern big data, streaming, and/or cloud-native technologies. 
Experience collaborating with cross-functional partners (e.g., product, analytics, and data science) to deliver scalable data solutions that support business, analytics, and AI needs. 
Or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Key Responsibilities:

• Design multi-turn conversations simulating real interactions between users and AI assistants using tools like calendar, email, maps, and drive.

• Craft dialogues demonstrating natural language, intelligent behavior, and contextual understanding across multiple turns.

• Iterate on conversation examples based on feedback to improve realism, clarity, and training value.
